description: This file defines classes related to Airties device metrics, including tlvAirtiesDeviceMetrics and cRadioInfo, with methods for managing device and radio information in a network context.

classes.name: tlvAirtiesDeviceMetrics
classes.description: Represents Airties device metrics with methods to access device info, manage radio list, and perform serialization tasks.

classes.name: cRadioInfo
classes.description: Represents individual radio information including radio ID and temperature.

methods.name: tlvAirtiesDeviceMetrics(uint8_t* buff, size_t buff_len, bool parse = false)
methods.description: Constructor initializing device metrics from buffer.

methods.name: tlvAirtiesDeviceMetrics(std::shared_ptr<BaseClass> base, bool parse = false)
methods.description: Constructor initializing device metrics from a base class object.

methods.name: ~tlvAirtiesDeviceMetrics()
methods.description: Destructor for tlvAirtiesDeviceMetrics.

methods.name: type()
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: vendor_oui()
methods.description: Returns the vendor OUI.

methods.name: tlv_id()
methods.description: Returns the TLV ID.

methods.name: uptime_to_boot()
methods.description: Returns the uptime since boot.

methods.name: cpu_loadtime_platform()
methods.description: Returns CPU load time.

methods.name: cpu_temperature()
methods.description: Returns CPU temperature.

methods.name: platform_totalmemory()
methods.description: Returns total memory of the platform.

methods.name: platform_freememory()
methods.description: Returns free memory of the platform.

methods.name: platform_cachedmemory()
methods.description: Returns cached memory of the platform.

methods.name: num_of_radios()
methods.description: Returns number of radios.

methods.name: radio_list(size_t idx)
methods.description: Returns a tuple indicating success and a reference to radio info at index.

methods.name: create_radio_list()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new radio info object.

methods.name: add_radio_list(std::shared_ptr<cRadioInfo> ptr)
methods.description: Adds a radio info object to the list.

methods.name: class_swap()
methods.description: Swaps class data for serialization.

methods.name: finalize()
methods.description: Finalizes the object, preparing it for use or serialization.

methods.name: get_initial_size()
methods.description: Returns initial size estimate for the object.
